## Pre-assembled Cable Kits

Solidyne offers cable and adapter kits designed to connect the console without the need to assemble cables. The options:

- Generic pre-assembled cable kit for new installations.
- Generic adapter cable kit for connecting the UNIDEX in pre-existing installations.
- User-customized kit.

The following links detail all available cable options:

Cable Kits for UX24 and UX18 models (PDF)

[https://www.solidynepro.com/descargas/folletos\_ingles/RJ45cablesUDX-EngCast.pdf](https://www.solidynepro.com/descargas/folletos_ingles/RJ45cablesUDX-EngCast.pdf)

<Note>
  See the **complete catalog** here: [General Cable Catalog](https://docs.solidyne.ar/es/accesorios/cables-y-adaptadores/catalogo)
</Note>
